text:
rachel: Quick pre-read for tomorrow's design crit 7: pin discoverability in compact compare. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/zzz/pin-discovery :mag:

dev: TL;DR: when rows collapse the pin icon hides behind the chevron. Test users said they "lost" pins after collapsing.

sam: Two low-cost alternatives: 1) persistent gutter pin (left of row) 2) collapsed-state chip: 'Pinned v2' next to model name 3) small sticky strip above table showing pinned items.

liza: I'm partial to the gutter pin for discoverability but worried about RTL and column shifts. We should render as absolute overlay inside the row container to avoid layout changes.

accessibility-bot: a11y notes: - pin button must have aria-pressed and aria-label="Toggle pin for side-by-side compare" - ensure Space/Enter toggles - hit target >= 32px - add sr-only text for perf badge values.

rachel: Microcopy: change tooltip from "Pin version" to "Keep model visible in compare". For badges use title 'Latency cost' and split values on hover.

dev: Edge-case: if a pinned model becomes hidden by filters we should surface a small non-blocking toast: "Pinned model hidden by filters. [Show pinned]" rather than silently hiding it.

sam: Keyboard shortcut: when a row is focused pressing "p" toggles pin. We'll need to gate it to avoid collisions. Example button markup:

```
<button class="cmp-pin" aria-pressed="false" aria-label="Toggle pin for side-by-side compare">
  
</button>
```

liza: Contrast: current perf badge green fails 4.5:1 at 12px. Options: darker token, 1px stroke, or visible text/icon fallback (L/M/H). Also don't rely on color alone.

rachel: UX proposal: default to gutter pin + collapsed chip fallback. If user pins >2 models show optional compact sticky strip. We'll prototype A: gutter+chip and B: gutter+strip.

dev: Implementation note: use absolute-position overlay to avoid shifting columns, and virtualize the sticky strip for large tables. Also emit analytics: pin.toggled {method: click|keyboard|shortcut, pattern: gutter|chip|strip}.

accessibility-bot: Add ACs: - pin is keyboard reachable and has aria-pressed - perf badges include aria-label or sr-only numbers - tooltips accessible via focus - contrast >= 4.5 or icon/text fallback.

product-ops: Added ticket PC-11011: "Compare: pin discoverability + a11y + filter reveal toast". Assigned to eng-frontend. Please include RTL and i18n overflow checks.

rachel: I'll mock both prototypes and drop links by 09:30. Please review copy (toast + tooltip) before the review.

sam: Quick question: should pinning auto-scroll the model into view? I think no by default, but offer a setting "Show pinned models when pinned".

liza: Agree with opt-in. Auto-scroll can be jarring. Instead show the toast with [Show] action.

dev: Noted. We'll implement the toast + optional user preference.

rachel: Thanks all . Demo in the design crit.
